AI Configuration
  • Each run uses this provider. Gemini stays the default — switch freely, settings are kept per provider.
  • Address of the OpenAI-compatible server (your own or a cloud service). Must end with /v1, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1 or https://api.groq.com/openai/v1
  • Get your free key at ai.google.dev
  • Flash and Lite models are free-tier eligible. Press Test Connection to load the live list from the provider.
  • Limits AI API usage per run (auto-tag, auto-organize)
  • Free tiers allow few requests/minute — keep 3500 ms or more for large runs. Set 0 on a paid plan or a local server.
